answer: Distinct Plume Capture: each identity must emit a plume signature from a certified thermal source whose waste-heat profile is registered against a wharf-side sensor array, with readings sealed in a hardware vault. The rule: two identities sharing one physical emitter fail cross-correlation within 90 seconds. Faking N identities forces N independent thermal sources plus N sensor registrations, costing roughly $400 each in hardware and calibration labor.
